prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 93.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Waiting Sign-In Journey Shift: Moves account sign-in to take place immediately after generation waiting completes rather than before adoption creation. (why: Sign-in conversion sits at 83.0% with users spending 567s mean time; letting them complete pet creation first increases commitment.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Progress Account Protection Banner: Updates the sign-in text to highlight automatic multi-device cloud backup and pet progress preservation. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back into their account.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Tray Launch Notification Banner: Adds explicit notification and desktop tray guidance while waiting for asset generation. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets failing to appear on desktop or users thinking the app stalled during rendering.)
3: [adoption, hint] Certificate Multi-Pet Backup Protection Copy: Adds explicit account sync validation copy on the adoption certificate screen before final rendering. (why: Prevents lost pet complaints (8 support tickets) by confirming companion registration details on the adoption certificate stage.)
4: [adoption, layout] Photo Upload Dual Column Studio Layout: Changes the photo upload screen layout to two-column with live photo preview and formatting guidelines. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet rendering failures or visual glitches caused by invalid photo inputs.)

scores.note: Sign-in has significant friction (83% conversion, 567s mean time); deferring sign-in builds intent but requires flow refactoring.
Directly addresses 8 support emails and sign-in dropoff with a simple config/copy change.
Home step loses 15.6% and has 3 support tickets regarding rendering clarity; notification UI update is low-to-medium cost.
Adoption loses 30.1% of users and 8 tickets report lost pets; copy addition is low cost with strong evidence.
Targets high-dropoff adoption step (30.1% loss) and upload issues, but requires significant UI rework.
